scope.selectionRule: Derive one queued source-specific extraction task for every candidate source attached to every C2-LT-B4 promotion row.
currentLimitations: This queue derives deep-read tasks; it does not contain completed source-specific extractions.

queueDefaults.minimumExtractionQuestion: For this C2-LT-B4 domain-source pair, what exact claim, endpoint, population/setting, mechanism/effect signal, uncertainty, transfer boundary and downgrade trigger can this source support without overclaiming?

remainingWork: Read each source in context and fill the required extraction slots.
